page_title: CEL 2-0 MAL | Celta Vigo v Mallorca 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is yellow-carded.
90+8' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) gets a yellow card.
90+8' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) is penalised for a foul. Jose Guzman had a clear view and blows his whistle.

90+5' 2 - 0 Williot Swedberg produces a sweet pass and picks out Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 2:0!
90+2' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
90+1' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is first to the rebound and sends a header goalwards but it's blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Celta Vigo win a corner.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Although Jagoba Arrasate (Mallorca) is just on the bench, Jose Guzman has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
86' It will be a substitution. Javier Llabres (Mallorca) is ready to enter the pitch as Antonio Sanchez walks off.
85' 1 - 0 Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) steps up to take the penalty and leaves the keeper helpless with a low shot inside the left post.
85' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
85' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Celta Vigo!
84' There's a break in play and referee Jose Guzman must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Celta Vigo using VAR. This could be interesting!
83' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' The attendance for today's match is 19689.

83' Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
81' A brilliant individual effort! Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
79' Substitution. Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) on for Javier Rueda.
78' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
77' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Torre (Mallorca) replacing Jan Virgili.
77' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) replaces Vedat Muriqi.
73' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
69' Substitution. Fernando Lopez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
69' Substitution. Matias Vecino is replaced by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo).
68' Here is a change. Omar Mascarell is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
68' Today's match ends for Toni Lato who will be replaced by Johan Mojica (Mallorca).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch so that Ferran Jutgla can be given a rest.
68' Matias Vecino (Celta Vigo) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
67' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

66' A lofted cross from Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag and Mallorca will take a corner.
62' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and Jose Guzman immediately signals a free kick.
60' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

56' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) can bury his head in the sand! He misses the rebound from inside the penalty box as he plants a header well wide of the left post! A typical school boy error! The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
55' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Leo Roman intercepts the ball.
54' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
52' Toni Lato (Mallorca) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
51' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) picks up an injury.
49' The ball is cleared after Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
47' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jose Guzman ignores the protests.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Jose Guzman blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+1' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' The cross into the penalty area from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
44' Pablo Duran doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
42' Jose Guzman interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Matias Vecino (Celta Vigo).
42' Jose Guzman blows his whistle as Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
40' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
36' It looks like Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) saw red with that tackle. Jose Guzman won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
35' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Leo Roman's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner.
34' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) inside the box.
31' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
29' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.

27' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
27' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) prepares to take a corner kick.
26' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' Mallorca control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
21' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
19' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Good work from Celta Vigo as they win a corner.

18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Celta Vigo, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
18' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Guzman blows for a foul. Celta Vigo have a free kick.
16' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
12' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
11' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) brings his opponent down. Jose Guzman has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.

10' What a chance that is! Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar.
9' Rough tackle by Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca win a free kick.
6' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' A cross into the box from Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is cleared.
2' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Jose Guzman.
